sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed. The external national payment network is down, so clearing cannot send payments and has a backlog of 114 items.
sbar.background: The payment network stopped answering and 100% of requests to it fail. The clearing log shows 'payment network timeout; item stays pending item_id=94'.
sbar.assessment: Root cause is an external outage of the national payment network (confidence 0.92), and no allowed action can fix it. Item 94 is valid and waits only because of the network timeout; the screening-standby restart is routine and shows no symptom.
sbar.recommendation: The incident commander escalated to the national payment network operator to restore service; follow up with them and confirm clearing drains its 114-item backlog once the network answers. Do not quarantine item 94, and have operations review the 114 delayed payments once they clear.
